name: @epoch/performance
description: Epoch Performance kernel (W034) — the deterministic, wall-clock-FREE performance engineering layer: typed, sealed, versioned PERFORMANCE BUDGETS (per operation class, an input-size -> allowed-operation-count envelope; budgets are DATA — swap a budget record, no code change); deterministic WORKLOAD GENERATORS (pure seed -> typed synthetic workloads at size N, the W031/W032 fixture pattern generalized to scale; same seed -> same workload digest); typed OPERATION COUNTERS (a counting hub + sealed measured-count records over the composition seam — counts, never time); pure BUDGET EVALUATION (workload digest + measured counts + budget record -> within/near/over verdicts carrying exact counts, reproducible by construction); and COMPLEXITY MODEL records (declared class per operation + measured count ratios across doubling ladder rungs proving the class). Zero wall-clock, zero randomness, zero network; every record is content-addressed canonical SHA-256. NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary.
